schema.description: A router, as the API returns it. Provider keys are never returned.

id.description: The router's unique identifier. The API addresses routers by `name`.

name.description: Unique within your account (or organization). Proposal Mode's `router` field and the gateway's `model` field name the router by it.

mode.description: How your app calls the router, fixed when it's created. `proposal` for `POST /v1/route`, `gateway` for the gateway.

router_model.description: The router model that scores each request

default.description: The name of the model the router falls back to when no other model is confident enough; the anchor of every decision. One of the enabled `target_models`.

confidence.description: Minimum score a model needs before it can be picked instead of the default. Higher is more conservative.

is_zdr.description: Zero data retention. When false, request and response payloads are kept for session replay on the dashboard.

target_models.description: The models the router can pick

items.description: A model the router can pick, priced as the router has it

name.description: The model's catalog name, which is also the router model's label for it. Proposal Mode returns it as a candidate's `model`.

provider.description: Where the gateway serves the model. Null on a Proposal Mode router.

model_id.description: The id the model is called by. On a gateway router, what Emissary sends the provider; on a Proposal Mode router, what `POST /v1/route` returns as a candidate's `model_id`, for your app to send.

enabled.description: A disabled model stays on the router but is never picked

cache_read_per_mtok.description: USD per million cache-read tokens. Null prices them as input tokens.

cache_write_per_mtok.description: USD per million cache-write tokens. Null prices them as input tokens.

context_window.description: The model's context window, in tokens

effort_routing_enabled.description: Lets the router pick the model's reasoning effort. Only on models the router model has efforts for (`efforts` in `GET /v1/router-models`); it's stored off on any other.

extra_fields.description: Per-model overrides, such as `always_on_reasoning` set to true for a model that can't turn reasoning off

items.title: RouterTargetModel

providers.description: The router's provider credentials, without their keys. Empty on a Proposal Mode router.

items.description: A provider credential on a gateway router. The key itself is never returned.

api_base_url.description: The endpoint used instead of the provider's default

items.title: RouterProvider

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of when the router was created

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the router's last change

schema.title: Router

403.description: The API key is not valid

404.description: None of your routers has this name
